See finding N1.

ok: 'conversation' is the shipped word for chat across the fr voice block and corpus; arrow U+2191 kept as the context requires; no 'ci-dessus' (link sits in a History row). Round-1 M2 resolved.

findings.suggested: Relire (optional; keep 'Réécouter' if the listener-side verb is preferred)
findings.reason: The shipped fr replay action in ui.common.speech.speak_control.replay_speech is 'Relire à voix haute' and its pair speak_aloud is 'Lire à voix haute'; the new play is 'Lire', so 'Relire' would pair with it and with the shipped string, while 'Réécouter' introduces a second verb for one action. Both are valid French; 'Relire' alone could be read as re-reading text, which is the reason to keep 'Réécouter'. Not a defect, no action required.

verdict: No blocker, major or minor. 1 NIT (replay verb vs shipped replay_speech), optional. Round-1 M1, M2, N1 are resolved in the bytes. Terminal.
